key.name: quick-replies
key.default: ["Yes, perfect", "On my way", "I'll call you back"]
key.description: Replies offered under an incoming message. Up to three are shown.

key.name: use-accent-color
key.description: Color the pill with the accent color of the desktop instead of amber.

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Which drawing shows the iPhone in the top bar: "phone" (a smartphone) or "handset" (the receiver of a landline phone).

key.name: call-control
key.summary: Answer and decline calls from this computer
key.description: Turn on call control in the engine as soon as an iPhone is linked.

key.name: phone-language
key.description: The language the drawings of the iPhone screens are written in: "en", "fr", or empty to guess from the languages of this computer.

key.name: muted
key.description: Nothing from the iPhone pops up on this computer until this is turned off again.

key.name: follow-do-not-disturb
key.summary: Stay quiet in Do Not Disturb
key.description: While Do Not Disturb is on, nothing from the iPhone shows in the top bar; unread messages are only counted.

key.name: quiet-while-sharing
key.summary: Stay quiet while the screen is shared
key.description: The same silence while the screen is shared or recorded.

key.name: calls-through-do-not-disturb
key.summary: Let calls through in Do Not Disturb
key.description: Show incoming calls even while Do Not Disturb is on.

key.name: phone-audio-here
key.summary: Play iPhone audio on this computer
key.description: Music and sounds of the iPhone play through this computer. Kept by the phone link service; this key mirrors it for Phone Settings.

key.name: lock-on-away
key.summary: Lock this computer when I walk away with my iPhone
key.description: Kept by the phone link service; this key mirrors it for Phone Settings.

key.name: lock-away-seconds
key.description: Seconds between the moment the iPhone is noticed gone and the lock.

key.name: battery-alerts
key.summary: Tell me when the iPhone battery is low
key.description: The icon of the top bar and the menu say so at 20 % and at 10 %. Nothing pops up.

key.name: keep-history
key.description: Notifications that left the iPhone stay listed under "Earlier" in the menu: the last 12 hours, 200 at most, in memory only, never on disk.

key.name: quiet-apps
key.summary: Apps that never grow the pill
key.description: Names or identifiers of iPhone apps whose notifications are only listed in the menu.

key.name: show-app-icons
key.description: Show the real icon of each iPhone app next to its notifications. To get it, the identifier of the app (like net.whatsapp.WhatsApp) is sent to Apple's App Store, once per app; the icon is then kept in ~/.cache/landline/app-icons. Turned off, nothing is sent: an app installed on this computer lends its icon, the others show their initials.

key.name: suggest-apps
key.summary: Suggest the official app when it is missing
key.description: The card of a notification says once per service that its official desktop app (or web client) is not on this computer, and where to get it.

key.name: suggested-apps
key.description: Written by the extension: the services (signal, telegram, discord, slack) whose missing app was already suggested once.

key.name: skip-running-apps
key.summary: Leave the pill to desktop apps that are open
key.description: A notification of an app whose official desktop app is open on this computer (and notifies by itself) does not grow the pill; it is still listed in the menu.

key.name: phone-links
key.description: Set by Phone Settings when Landline opens tel: and callto: links; the extension then listens for them on the session bus.

key.name: phone-links-offered
key.description: Set once the top bar menu has offered "Use Landline for phone links" (only when no other app opens tel: and callto: links): it is never offered there again. The option stays in Phone Settings.

key.name: phone-links-previous
key.description: Written by Phone Settings: the default handlers of tel: and callto: before Landline took them ("tel=org.example.App.desktop"), given back when the option is turned off.

key.name: link-mode
key.description: "lean": stay linked for notifications, connect for messages and calls when needed. "full": keep everything connected. Kept by the phone link service; this key mirrors it for Phone Settings.

key.name: link-mode-state
key.description: Written by the extension for Phone Settings, never read back: empty when the phone link service has one mode only, else the mode in force, a colon, and why it is not the one chosen ("full:phone_keeps_link").

key.name: forget-request
key.description: Set by Phone Settings to ask the Shell to open "Forget This iPhone…"; put back to false at once.

key.name: tour-request
key.description: Set by Phone Settings › Engine ("Link My iPhone…") to ask the Shell to open the setup tour once the engine answers; put back to false at once.

key.name: steady-request
key.description: Set by Phone Settings ("Keep the link steady", shown only while it is not set up) to ask the Shell to open the setup step that sets it up; put back to false at once.
